# Responsive Behaviour Checklist (375px and 1280px): Dynamic Survey Viewer

**Purpose**: Validate that the responsive requirements are specific enough to be gated — that the two
smoke-test widths, the reflow floor, and the per-screen expectations are written as decidable statements
rather than as an aspiration to "work on mobile".
**Created**: 2026-10-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [.specify/memory/constitution.md](../../../.specify/memory/constitution.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Author's review pass**: items CHK004 and CHK007 failed on 2026-10-08 and are fixed by the revised
FR-058 and SC-008 — see [Checklist review](../spec.md#checklist-review--session-2026-10-08).

## Requirement Clarity — the widths themselves

- [ ] CHK001 Are the gate widths stated as exact pixel values rather than as device names or breakpoint labels? [Clarity, Spec §FR-058]
- [ ] CHK002 Is "works at this width" decomposed into decidable conditions — no horizontal scrolling, no clipped or truncated label — rather than left as a judgement? [Measurability, Spec §FR-058]
- [ ] CHK003 Is it stated whether 375px and 1280px are the only widths that must work, or the widths that are gated? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-058]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the reflow floor stated at the width WCAG 2.1 AA criterion 1.4.10 is measured at, given the constitution binds this feature to AA? [Conflict, Spec §FR-058] — **failed: 375px was the stated floor; fixed by adding the 320px reflow requirement**
- [ ] CHK005 Is the orientation assumption stated or explicitly out of scope? [Assumption, Spec §FR-058]

## Coverage — which screens and which states

- [ ] CHK006 Does the responsive requirement cover every flow, including the error, not-found and confirmation screens, rather than only the survey pages? [Coverage, Spec §FR-058, §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK007 Are target-size requirements stated for both dimensions, so a control cannot satisfy the height rule while remaining too narrow to hit? [Gap, Spec §FR-058] — **failed: height only; fixed by the revised FR-058**
- [ ] CHK008 Is the layout of a long question list, a long option list and a long attachment list addressed at the narrow width? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK009 Are the page-level error summary and the per-question error text both covered at the narrow width, where they compete for space? [Coverage, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the attachment list's layout at 375px specified well enough that a file name, a size and a Remove control can coexist without truncation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-025, §FR-058]

## Consistency with the other principles

- [ ] CHK011 Does the responsive requirement avoid prescribing a layout technique, leaving that to the plan? [Consistency, Spec §FR-058]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the no-truncation rule consistent with the contract's maximum field lengths, so a 300-character question title has a stated outcome at 375px? [Consistency, Contract §2]
- [ ] CHK013 Is colour at every width still required to come from tokens, with no width-specific exception? [Consistency, Spec §FR-059]
- [ ] CHK014 Does the focus indicator requirement hold at both widths, including where a control is reflowed? [Consistency, Spec §FR-056]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Is the browser smoke test's pass condition stated in the spec, rather than only in the constitution's gate list? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK016 Can the responsive criterion be decided by someone who did not write the spec? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the owner of the smoke-test gate identified, so the criterion has someone to fail? [Traceability, Spec §SC-008]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK008 is a known soft spot: the spec constrains the outcome (no truncation, no horizontal scrolling) but names no layout for long lists, which is deliberate — layout is the Solution Architect's
